Order 
The petitioner/victim on whose complaint case in Crime No.19 of 2022 assigned against one Ajaykumar and one Rani, on completion of investigation, charge sheet filed in Spl.S.C.No.58 of 2022 for the offence under Sections 294(b), 376, 420 and 506(i) of IPC and Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s),
3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of SC/ST (POA) Act, which is pending trial before the Subordinate Court,
Theni.
The petitioner had sent a representation on 01.10.2024 stating that on behalf of the petitioner, one Mr.K.Bagavath Singh, Advocate, to be appointed as Special Public Prosecutor.
The petitioner invoking Rule 4 Sub-clause 5 of SC/ST(POA) Act, had made such request to the District Collector, thereafter, no action has been taken.
The petitioner had also sent a reminder.
Hence, the above petition.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.

The Inspector of Police, All Women Police Station, Andipatti, appeared and submitted that in this case, investigation was completed, charge sheet filed and now, the case is posted for trial on 09.01.2025 for examination of L.W.1 and L.W.2.

Since the District Collector has to pass an appropriate order on the petitioner's request dated 01.10.2024, it has to be passed well before 09.01.2025, so that in the event of Special Public Prosecutor being appointed, he can get acquainted with the case and proceed without delay.

3. In view of the above, the District Collector, Theni, is directed to consider the petitioner's representation dated 01.10.2024 and pass orders on or before 02.01.2025.
4.
With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
